title: micropolypodium sikkimense
intro: Micropolypodium sikkimense, commonly known as Himalayan Polypodium, is a type of fern that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of arthritis, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Micropolypodium sikkimense include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
